description.p: Purun is a native port of LocoRoco 2 for the PSP, made by static recompilation on PortableKit: the game's PSP code is translated ahead of time into native code and runs on a reimplementation of the PSP system software, with Vulkan graphics, gamepad support and PSP-compatible saves.

Purun does not include any game assets or original game files. You must provide your own legally obtained copy of LocoRoco 2 (UCES-01059): the first start checks that copy, accepts only that release, and sets the game up from it.
Purun is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony or the game's developers or publishers.
